title: Kaya Toast
description: Kaya Toast is a dish from Singapore prepared with chicken egg, coconut milk, pandan leaves, white bread. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Gently thicken the coconut, palm sugar and egg mixture over low heat, stirring continuously until the kaya is smooth; avoid scrambled eggs.
Toast these ingredients over medium heat for about 6 minutes, turning frequently to prevent scorching.
Arrange the already cooked and prepared components for serving, keeping hot and cold components at their safe temperatures.
